about: Dogfood baseline for the §17.4 bar (canvas/docs/agent-layer-design.md). Two Claude Code testers (claude-opus-5-5, effort medium) drove mcp-excalidraw-server 2.0.0 via the excalidraw-skill CLI on 2026-09-25 (canvas/docs/dogfood-synthesis.md). Every metric comes from src/transcript.ts run on the tester transcript over the given window.

method.toolCalls: tool_use blocks in the window, deduplicated by block id. Counts every tool (Bash, Read, Skill, Write, ...), not just canvas CLI calls.
method.tokens: output_tokens from API usage (deduplicated by message.id, includes thinking) + user-side text in the window (prompt, skill text, tool results) at 3.2 bytes/token (design §9.5) + images at (w*h)/750 after the API resize to <= 1568 px long edge and <= 1.15 MP. Cache reads and the session's system-prompt cache write are excluded: both are fixed or scale with turns x context, not with the task.
method.wallSeconds: first to last user/assistant record in the window.
method.window: from the task prompt (inclusive) to the next orchestrator prompt (exclusive). It includes writing the report and the one-line summary the brief asks for.

runs.tester: A, one command at a time
runs.fixture: eval/fixtures/yct-ride-hailing.jsonl (this window, trimmed: user/assistant records only; tool inputs, assistant text and thinking dropped; user text replaced by same-byte-length filler; images cut to the PNG header)

report.canvasCliCalls: ~40 (17 did real work: 1 add, 9 apply, 8 screenshot, 1 describe)
report.wall: ~6 min of tool time (331 s first status to final export)

runs.windowNote: Starts at the 'change of tool' prompt. The 2 min before it were a failed attempt with the claude.ai Excalidraw connector (3 tool calls, OAuth), not part of the task.

report.canvasCliCalls: 34 (8 mutating, 7 screenshot, 5 export, 3 get, 2 describe, 2 query, 2 snapshot)

runs.tester: A, round 3 (only tester A ran the BST figure)
runs.windowNote: Round 3 of a running session: no skill loading or setup inside the window, which makes this baseline small. It includes the chat answers the round-3 prompt asked for.

report.source: canvas/docs/dogfood-synthesis.md (round 3 table and pain #3, #8); no report section of its own

referenceNote: ride-hailing takes the stricter (lower) of the two testers per measure: calls from batch (32), tokens from yct (59997). Bar: <= 10.67 calls and <= 11999 tokens for ride-hailing; <= 3.33 calls and <= 2605 tokens for BST.

defects.ride-hailing: Absolute bar (0 missed). Manifests of the dogfood's own final scenes: elkdraw/test/fixtures/dogfood/{yct,batch}/defects.json (14 and 8 unfixed). A new run's scene needs its own by-eye manifest; src/score.ts then counts missed.
defects.bstNote: No BST scene or manifest was exported (test/fixtures/README.md). The BST missed-defect count is a by-eye number passed to --missed.
